body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its 15.4-inch premium notebook pc 'P-510' during CES 2009, which delivers both high mobility and high performance. Weighing around 2kg, the P-510 is equipped with 64GB SSD as well as HDD.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
